scope: 520 full matches plus 28 overtime continuations; focused probes excluded from win rates

trap_blocks_attacker.reason: That unit cannot take another action

normal_responses_refused.normal_attack: That unit cannot take another action
normal_responses_refused.counter_cast: That unit cannot take another action

cast-blitz-results.preemptive_black_blitz_blocks_cast: This unit cannot use that ability
cast-blitz-results.limits: Delivery was cooperative. Cleave/Ruin/Strike response order uses healthy-unit damage thresholds; this is not an exhaustive game solver. Earlier denial remains possible.

limitations: Assigned builds are not organic picks.
Heuristic players share candidate-generation blind spots, especially movement/action denial and withdrawals.
CPU thinking is wall-clock and hardware/load dependent.
No human playtest, fresh browser verification or independent agent review.

metric_notes.ability_games: Counts participant appearances with a cast, out of 2 × cohort matches; not distinct matches.
metric_notes.checkpoints: First White-turn snapshot in the phase includes both sides; new-phase income may not yet be paid to Black. Use own_turn_arrival_resources for comparisons.
metric_notes.opportunities: Turns where a considered candidate passed legality, not exhaustive target coverage.
metric_notes.late: Continuations begin on ply 73; their length/plies count only continuation side-turns.
